# pai brainstorm

Round table: a moderator and N cloud participants discuss a goal on a shared board

```
pai brainstorm [GOAL] [command] [options]
```

pai brainstorm "<goal>" starts one moderator and N participants (cloud workers, detached) and returns at once; they post, wait and reply on a shared append-only board until the moderator posts CLOSED or the deadline passes. The result lands in ~/.pai/brainstorm/<id>/result.md and as a message to the calling session. The board is written only through `pai brainstorm post`. Cloud only, unless --local.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GOAL` | no | What the round table should think through |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--participants N` | number | 3 | Number of participants |
| `--lenses A;B;C` | string | — | Semicolon-separated lenses, one per participant (cycled; default: six built-in lenses) |
| `--max-minutes M` | number | 20 | Time box in minutes (the moderator gets 3 more to close) |
| `--rounds R` | number | 3 | Moderated rounds |
| `--context FILES` | string | — | Comma-separated files every participant should read |
| `--local` | flag | — | Run the workers on the local provider instead of the cloud |
| `--wait` | flag | — | Block until the board closes, then print result.md |

```sh
pai brainstorm "should the router cache embeddings?" --participants 3 --max-minutes 15
pai brainstorm watch bs-20261127-120000-ab12
pai brainstorm ls
```

### pai brainstorm post

Post to a brainstorm board (the only way the board is written)

```
pai brainstorm post ID [TEXT] [options]
```

Appends one numbered post. The text is the argument, or --file, or stdin when the text is -. The role is --as, else PAI_BRAINSTORM_ROLE, else anon. A moderator post starting with CLOSED closes the board and writes result.md. A closed board refuses posts (exit 1).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Brainstorm id (bs-...) |
| `TEXT` | no | The post text (or - for stdin) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--as ROLE` | string | — | Role to post as: moderator, p1..pN (default: $PAI_BRAINSTORM_ROLE, else anon) |
| `--file PATH` | string | — | Read the text from this file |

```sh
pai brainstorm post bs-20261127-120000-ab12 "I would start small" --as p1
```

### pai brainstorm wait

Block until the board has posts after --since, is closed, or the deadline passes

```
pai brainstorm wait ID [options]
```

Prints the new posts, then one line `-- board <id> last=<n> state=<new|deadline|closed>`. Exit 0 = new posts, 3 = deadline (nothing new), 4 = closed. Exit 3 and 4 are normal outcomes. An unknown board is exit 1.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Brainstorm id (bs-...) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--since N` | number | 0 | Last post number you have seen |
| `--max SECONDS` | number | — | Give up after this many seconds (default: until the board deadline) |

```sh
pai brainstorm wait bs-20261127-120000-ab12 --since 3 --max 600
```

### pai brainstorm watch

Live view of a board until it closes or the deadline passes

```
pai brainstorm watch ID
```

Prints every post in time order, then each new one as it arrives. Exit 0 at close or deadline.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Brainstorm id (bs-...) |

```sh
pai brainstorm watch bs-20261127-120000-ab12
```

### pai brainstorm show

Goal, state, workers and every post of a board

```
pai brainstorm show ID [options]
```

Prints the goal, the state (open, closed, deadline passed), the participants with their worker ids, and every post.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Brainstorm id (bs-...) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Machine-readable JSON output |

```sh
pai brainstorm show bs-20261127-120000-ab12
pai brainstorm show bs-20261127-120000-ab12 --json
```

### pai brainstorm ls

List brainstorm boards, newest first

```
pai brainstorm ls
```

One line per board: id, state, post count, goal.

```sh
pai brainstorm ls
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai brainstorm post` | Post to a brainstorm board (the only way the board is written) |
| `pai brainstorm wait` | Block until the board has posts after --since, is closed, or the deadline passes |
| `pai brainstorm watch` | Live view of a board until it closes or the deadline passes |
| `pai brainstorm show` | Goal, state, workers and every post of a board |
| `pai brainstorm ls` | List brainstorm boards, newest first |
